claims: Ramadan in 2026 is expected to end on the evening of Thursday, March 19, or Friday, March 20, 2026.
Ramadan concludes with the sighting of the new crescent moon.
The sighting of the new crescent moon marks the beginning of the festival of Eid al-Fitr.
Dates are traditionally confirmed by moon-sighting committees.
Most projections point to a March 19-20 completion of Ramadan in 2026.
